Use in place of a rinse-out mask. Recommended after matching shampoo: detangle wet hair, divide into two sections, use 2-3 pumps on one section and repeat elsewhere. Optional intensive-care Metal DX mask and recommended matching leave-in.
Two-years-damage headline is footnoted to a shampoo+serum+leave-in instrumental system test; another molecular-repair claim refers to 15 serum applications, not proof of one-use superiority.
